answer: Random-beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop a sybil grove taking root. Each agent posts a 20-token bond and a heartbeat proof each epoch, a sonnet-like form that must scan. The beacon picks 5% at random; a picked agent must solve a puzzle in one epoch or lose its bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 20,000 tokens; 95% are caught within 20 epochs, so losses dwarf any fake gain. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, their bond on a ledge.
